items.name: Starmoon Robe
items.progressionUse: First HP robe for early survivability before saving for 60 HP gear.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer lists 100 Gold and +30 HP. Gamezebo lists Rare/B tier, +30 HP, and 1.8K Gold. Exact cost needs in-game shop verification. Image downloaded from the matched BloxInformer item asset.

items.name: Golden Reverie Robe
items.progressionUse: Lower listed-cost +60 HP robe once stronger enemies punish a small health pool.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer lists 500 Gold and +60 HP. Gamezebo lists Epic/A tier, +60 HP, and 12K Gold. Exact cost needs in-game shop verification. Image downloaded from the matched BloxInformer item asset.

items.name: Starlight Robe
items.progressionUse: High-cost late robe target for boss and tougher farming loops; same listed HP as Golden Reverie.
items.verificationNote: BloxInformer lists 5,000 Gold and +60 HP. Gamezebo lists Epic/S tier, +60 HP, and 12K Gold. Exact cost needs in-game shop verification. Image downloaded from the matched BloxInformer item asset.
